sources.recommend_reason_zh: StateBench用四个难度等级测试长文档状态跟踪，发现recurrent和hybrid比transformers泛化更远，前沿模型在更难任务和长输入下失效。

en.reason: StateBench tests long-context state tracking across four difficulty levels and finds recurrent and hybrid models generalize farther than transformers, while frontier models fail on harder tasks and longer inputs.

items.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity

sources.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.title_zh: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学
sources.title_original: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章展示 Google Antigravity 搭配 Cheminformatics Skills，在真实肺癌治疗案例中让 agent 搜索数千化合物、做 matched molecular pair analysis，并在一小时内提出 novel rigidified macrocycles 及合成路线，而传统单次迭代常需多天。

en.reason: In a real lung cancer case, Google Antigravity with Cheminformatics Skills let an agent search thousands of compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles and synthesis routes within an hour, versus days for typical iteration.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Dependabot 现已支持 Agent Package Manager，可自动为 apm.yml 中声明的 git 依赖提交 pull request 并重新生成 apm.lock.yaml，覆盖版本更新而非安全更新，所有 GitHub 套餐均可用，并将登陆 GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24。

en.reason: Dependabot version updates now support Agent Package Manager, opening pull requests for git dependencies declared in apm.yml, regenerating apm.lock.yaml, and covering version rather than security updates on all GitHub plans, with GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24 support coming.

sources.title_original: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 在 90 个 AppWorld 任务上让 CUGA、Hermes、Deep Agents 共用 GLM-5.3-flash，完成率从 30% 到 81%，SGC 为 20/8/2，说明 harness 需匹配企业多应用 API 工作负载。

en.reason: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment.

items.title: GitHub Desktop 新增短时效认证令牌 / GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens

sources.title: GitHub Desktop 新增短时效认证令牌 / GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
sources.title_zh: GitHub Desktop 新增短时效认证令牌
sources.title_en: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
sources.title_original: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 起，符合条件账户登录可使用短时自动刷新认证令牌，降低泄露令牌可用时长，并自动为 GitHub API 请求和 Git 操作续期；功能正逐步覆盖，暂不含 GitHub Enterprise Server。

en.reason: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 and later now gives eligible accounts short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens, reducing a leaked token's usable window and auto-renewing them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, though the rollout excludes GitHub Enterprise Server.
